name: Poopinteetha
source: A self proclaimed goddess and only inhabitant of "the land of Poopoo" who kidnaps any player who loses 3 Smash rounds in a row with the fighter Paulina and forces them to eat feces until their spirit breaks... or at least that's what the legends says.
